function.name: read
function.description: Read a bounded slice of a workspace-relative file. Use mount 'workspace' for the current coding worktree.

function.name: patch
function.description: Create or update one workspace-relative file with an idempotent unified diff.

function.name: shell
function.description: Run a policy-checked shell command with a workspace-relative cwd.

function.name: list
function.description: List a workspace-relative directory, bounded by depth. Use target { mount: 'workspace', path: '.' } for the root.

function.name: wait
function.description: Register a durable wait condition and settle this execution.

function.name: send_message
function.description: Send a durable coordination message through the owning workspace.

function.name: assign_work
function.description: Assign a new bounded Work outcome to the current Workspace or one of its direct child Workspaces. Runtime binds identity, revisions, authority, and predecessor provenance.

targetWorkspaceRef.description: Omit for the current Workspace; otherwise use an opaque ref returned by list_workspaces/read_workspace.

reason.description: Why this Work is being assigned now.

function.name: list_workspaces
function.description: List the current Workspace, active direct children, and in-flight formation summaries using scoped opaque refs.

function.name: read_workspace
function.description: Read one current/direct-child Workspace responsibility and open-work summary by scoped opaque ref.

function.name: accept_result
function.description: Accept one exact PASS result from an active direct-child Workspace using a scoped result ref. Runtime binds Work, revision and Verification identities.

function.name: update_plan
function.description: Create or revise the current Work plan. This records progress only; it does not execute steps or complete the Work.

function.name: claim_completion
function.description: Claim that the current Work is complete. The claim triggers independent verification; the Work itself is not completed by this action.

claim.description: Why the Work is complete: what was produced and how it satisfies the completion expectation.

function.name: propose_workspace
function.description: Propose a durable child workspace for an independent long-lived responsibility. A human governance decision (Approve/Reject/Modify) is required before the child is created.

name.description: Stable short name for the proposed child workspace.

rationale.description: Why this responsibility should be a long-lived child workspace rather than local work.

function.name: declare_dependency
function.description: Declare that the current Work consumes an expected deliverable. Only the deterministic runtime matcher can later satisfy the dependency — declaring it never asserts satisfaction.

function.name: produce_deliverable
function.description: Record a formal deliverable from the exact current Work revision and versioned Artifact refs. This does not verify quality.

function.name: deliver
function.description: Deliver an existing formal deliverable from the current child Workspace to its direct parent. Delivery does not itself satisfy quality or acceptance.

function.name: read
function.description: Read a bounded slice of a workspace-relative file. Use mount 'workspace' for the current coding worktree.

function.name: patch
function.description: Create or update one workspace-relative file with an idempotent unified diff.

function.name: shell
function.description: Run a policy-checked shell command with a workspace-relative cwd.

function.name: list
function.description: List a workspace-relative directory, bounded by depth. Use target { mount: 'workspace', path: '.' } for the root.

function.name: wait
function.description: Register a durable wait condition and settle this execution.

function.name: send_message
function.description: Send a durable coordination message through the owning workspace.

function.name: assign_work
function.description: Assign a new bounded Work outcome to the current Workspace or one of its direct child Workspaces. Runtime binds identity, revisions, authority, and predecessor provenance.

targetWorkspaceRef.description: Omit for the current Workspace; otherwise use an opaque ref returned by list_workspaces/read_workspace.

reason.description: Why this Work is being assigned now.

function.name: list_workspaces
function.description: List the current Workspace, active direct children, and in-flight formation summaries using scoped opaque refs.

function.name: read_workspace
function.description: Read one current/direct-child Workspace responsibility and open-work summary by scoped opaque ref.

function.name: accept_result
function.description: Accept one exact PASS result from an active direct-child Workspace using a scoped result ref. Runtime binds Work, revision and Verification identities.

function.name: update_plan
function.description: Create or revise the current Work plan. This records progress only; it does not execute steps or complete the Work.

function.name: claim_completion
function.description: Claim that the current Work is complete. The claim triggers independent verification; the Work itself is not completed by this action.

claim.description: Why the Work is complete: what was produced and how it satisfies the completion expectation.

function.name: propose_workspace
function.description: Propose a durable child workspace for an independent long-lived responsibility. A human governance decision (Approve/Reject/Modify) is required before the child is created.

name.description: Stable short name for the proposed child workspace.

rationale.description: Why this responsibility should be a long-lived child workspace rather than local work.

function.name: declare_dependency
function.description: Declare that the current Work consumes an expected deliverable. Only the deterministic runtime matcher can later satisfy the dependency — declaring it never asserts satisfaction.

function.name: produce_deliverable
function.description: Record a formal deliverable from the exact current Work revision and versioned Artifact refs. This does not verify quality.

function.name: deliver
function.description: Deliver an existing formal deliverable from the current child Workspace to its direct parent. Delivery does not itself satisfy quality or acceptance.
